description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.13 boss 1): the crown's oath by breach. It starts when Fort Aldmere's gate falls (a stage-4 giant breaks it). In the bailey the battle (world.aldmere.iron_regiment_arena, FortBattle: the Wall, the Charge, the Last Stand) runs until Corvane yields; the yield prompt's Spare or Strike settles boss.corvane.outcome (spared / slain), and this stage writes the oath's outcome breach (first write wins) with oath.crown.met (M8 gate, F39: a giant that never met the herald has met the crown's oath now, as Edda's and Sedge's resolutions write their met flags) - quest.oath_crown's meet and resolve stages then pay. Given up once the oath is won another way.

stages.objective: Break the Iron Regiment in Fort Aldmere's bailey until Corvane yields
stages.waiting_text: Enter the bailey through the broken gate: the portcullis closes behind you. Break the formations' banners, smash the wall ballistae, and bring down Corvane's guard until he yields - then spare or strike him.
